content.text:
The build completed successfully! The axiom footprint is exactly `propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound`. Great.

Now let's verify:
- The build log contains no errors/warnings (other than the axiom prints).
- The olean exists.
- Compute SHA256 of the olean.
- Compile the olean check file.

Let's read the build log and check the olean.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments: {"code": "let r = await tools.pwsh({ description: \"Check build log and olean\", command: \"Get-Content tmp\\\\sheaf\\\\xif\\\\paper\\\\_S1942_build.log; Write-Output '---'; Get-ChildItem .lake\\\\build\\\\lib\\\\lean\\\\tmp\\\\sheaf\\\\xif\\\\paper\\\\S1942PrePsiFiveActual.olean | Format-List FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-FileHash .lake\\\\build\\\\lib\\\\lean\\\\tmp\\\\sheaf\\\\xif\\\\paper\\\\S1942PrePsiFiveActual.olean -Algorithm SHA256 | Format-List\" });\nconsole.log(r.stdout.text); console.log(r.stderr.text);\n", "description": "Inspect build log and olean"}
